sharedProcedure.authorship: All MU213 profile, admission, scheduling, capacity and ending completions are explicit NEW spell-local proposals for these two identities only. They neither amend historical monsters nor confer class features or CR. Preserve every native card unchanged beside the procedure.
sharedProcedure.casting: Cleric/Druid/Wizard Necromancy rank9,minimumclass17,base26RP,Action120ft. Require actual acquired/prepared source, real components, Action and priced RP. Field V/S/F; Plague V/S/M-or-F, no invented costly reagent. Pay actual chronological cadence and concentration transitions once before counter window. Counter/late failure never refunds. Ready uses actual paid setup/held concentration/Reaction release/next-regular-start expiry; manifestation clock begins on successful release.
sharedProcedure.corpseIdentity: One physical body/death-event allocation per genuine currently dead creature body. Living0HP is not a corpse. Fragments sharing one identity cannot be counted twice; severed fragments must remain recorded and cannot grow into extra bodies. Explicitly protected/nonanimatable source remains protected. Raised/copied/illusory/summoned/spent-fuel remains do not generate a fresh legal corpse by renaming them. A separately legal resurrection/reconstruction and later real death uses its own exact contract; these spells grant neither. A protection must actually prohibit animation or allocation to block this conversion. Mass Resurrection Denial prohibits corpse-local return-to-life only; it is not an animation ward. Sufficient-remains eligibility for independent resurrection of a consumed allocation remains MU214-C01, and neither eligibility nor permanent ineligibility is implied.
sharedProcedure.conversion: NEW two full chassis in PROFILES. Skeleton requires actual articulated skeletal remains; zombie retains actual non-skeletal corpse material, including non-Humanoid anatomy. No age or Small/Medium/Humanoid-only restriction. Every actual corpse category has the same deterministic material-preserving mapping: skeletal -> skeleton; otherwise zombie. Source-recognized construct corpse can map; arbitrary object rubble is not a corpse. Missing limbs/senses limit actual actions, not admission as an additional corpse. No donor HP, CR, spells, resources, skills, powers, equipment, memories or identity doctrine inherited. Source-recognized constructed corpses remain conditional under MU214-C02 until a real source establishes that category and physical body. Destroyed/inert ACT-TOY-SENTINEL or arbitrary rubble is not silently promoted to it.
sharedProcedure.material: Body is exclusively consumed as animation fuel in the allocation ledger while its real matter persists physically. Assign animation ID distinct from original body ID; keep original death, anatomy, harvest and custody history. On ending record spent inert remains, never a fresh death/harvest/corpse entitlement. Existing external equipment stays actual owner/custodian/condition; no automatic wield proficiency, loot, tools, XP or new gear. No disintegration of independent matter merely because spell ends.
sharedProcedure.control: NEW permanent/temporary control is a one-way command relation, not shared sight, facts or soul ownership. One normal owner Bonus Action group command selects one of these actual cohorts and a finite order/member assignment. All selected members can each perform one legal Action in the attached phase. This expressly extends the single-body offensive allowance for that one cohort; it consumes the controller shared companion command/offense/support allowance for the numbered round and cannot combine with another owned-asset allowance. No additional owner turn or reset for multiple casts/controllers.
sharedProcedure.commandLifecycle: NEW commands use the operative magical source relation without a distance ceiling, including bodies outside Plague admission geometry; no new perception or remote-information feedback. Controller must be capable at issuance. Later incapacity or removal alone does not cancel an already issued order; actual source ending or body/target ineligibility does. Finite move routes are executed only through space the body can actually navigate with its own senses; attacks name a known target that the body must independently perceive and legally reach. Stable body-ID order immediately after the original creator regular turn; no separate body turn. Order expires at that phase end if impossible, suppressed, disabled, unaffordable or budget-starved. No bank/replay/retarget/refund. Later order replaces unexecuted earlier order; an actual controller change is arbitrated by its exact external source: revalidate affected pending commands against that source; it never resets source ownership, stats or phase history. A Charm Creature forced order is cancelled and its unused offensive reservation released if that Charm ends, retaining BA/costs and without spending hard denial. Existing permanent relation resumes only under the actual external control source ending rule, not an invented control override.
sharedProcedure.default: NEW without a valid order, capable members have only defensive movement up to actual remaining Speed and Dodge at the original attached phase; no autonomous attacks, Help, labor, casts, searches, item activation or reactions. Suppressed/disabled members cannot act. Original creator virtual regular markers continue through absence/incapacity/death under the bound scheduling contract; no duplicate phase or fresh budget from control change. Dead/incapacitated controller cannot issue orders; no automatic hostility or successor authority.
sharedProcedure.actions: NEW group order may assign Strike, Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Search or simple physical carry/place/pull task. One Action per participating body; no multiattack, professional training, crafting/research credit or automated supply creation. Movement/standing uses actual terrain/pose, occupancy and carrying. Different members retain distinct target/roll/condition/HP histories. Each attack creates its own damage root with actual body as dealer, not automatically caster Null/status. Critical doubles dice only; no count-based merged damage shortcut.
sharedProcedure.HP: Apply only genuinely acquired source-qualified maximumHP modifiers that explicitly include this creation. Necromancy is not Conjuration; Wizard standard-minion scaling/cap and unrelated donor powers do not apply. Full new HP at first lawful animation; no rebind/refill of consumed bodies. Later maxHP rise adds capacity only; fall clamps per accepted ledger. At ordinary0 end only that animation and leave spent remains/cargo. Qualifying actual Null damage at0 gives Disabled/Incapacitated/Speed0 without destruction while parent persists. Actual eligible healing above0 clears Disabled, not costs/timers/history. Independent expiry or dispel still ends a disabled body. NEW spell-local lifecycle bridge: for these two HP-only animations specifically, adopt qualifying Null nonlethal zero as Disabled/Incapacitated/Speed0 instead of destruction. This is an explicit authored endpoint selection, not an assertion that Wizard standard-undead-minion scope already includes these spells. A caster Veil never transfers to a body; only the actual creation-time damage dealer can qualify the root.
sharedProcedure.suppression: NEW suppressing an individual animation/control manifestation makes that real body inert at its actual pose; keeps HP, source deadline, allocation and external cargo. No disappearance, free placement, healing or replacement. Inert body remains damageable under this chassis; real support/falling follows its own rules. Resume only a still-existing positiveHP source into legally available expression; no overlap/crushing or replay of missed commands. Unavailable physical clearance keeps that expression inert until actually clear. Suppression at formation prevents that payload under actual incoming/outgoing suppression scope, with paid costs retained. Formation clarification: first revalidate actual corpse inputs, then resolve local output manifestations. A real applicable suppression field blocks only its local output; it does not make otherwise-valid corpse selection illegal or cancel unrelated outputs. The blocked input remains unconsumed, with no queued creation when suppression ends. Field still selects exactly eight; this is source suppression, not permission to cast on fewer than eight.
sharedProcedure.termination: Each animated body is a distinct ongoing rank9 application of one generating cast. A targeted eligible dispel can end its captured application; Greater Dispel uses one generating-cast check for captured bodies, not global off-area ending. No unauthorized provider acquisition inferred. Source expiry/concentration ending for Plague ends all remaining applications; Field has no natural expiry. Every terminal callback is idempotent; real cargo remains at actual physical position/support. No future original body/charges/matter regeneration.
sharedProcedure.privacy: Public legal selection differs from paid hidden predicates. Plague returns no corpse-count/identity/inventory diagnostic to caster. Internal ledger can record hidden outcomes without player disclosure. No corpse becomes immune merely because it is hidden, nor eligible merely because it is named.

spellLocalProcedure.admission: NEW choose exactly eight distinct actual eligible bodies within120ft, each perceived with line of effect and complete physical allocation/anatomy. Choose skeleton only for actual skeletal remains; zombie for retained corpse tissue/material; a stated mixture is permitted. If fewer than8 are knowingly legal, no cast/no payment, not a reduced-effect alternative. At resolution atomically revalidate all8. A late invalid/protected/reserved/consumed body makes the paid Field payload fail entirely with no fallback or copied corpse. This atomic input-validity rule is separate from the subsequent local suppression of valid output manifestations. Eight legal selected inputs may yield seven active bodies when exactly one formation is suppressed by a real applicable source; no substitute or later payload is generated.
spellLocalProcedure.permanence: NEW select one continuing animation-and-control application per body, with no natural deadline and no concentration. This reconciles permanent control with Until dispelled: neither a rest, elapsed minute, distance, owner absence nor owner death ends these applications. Actual eligible dispelling/ordinary destruction/source-specific ending does. Ending does not leave uncontrolled active undead; it leaves spent inert original matter.
spellLocalProcedure.capacity: NEW each successful cast adds a distinct eight-body cohort. No cap3, cap1, global population limit or replacement. Failed recast changes no prior cohort. Rebinding an existing animation does not create another body or HP pool. The paid group command still selects only one cohort per shared command allowance. No new remote voluntary dismissal is added; ending uses a real dispel or source-specific terminal.
spellLocalProcedure.service: Permanent service remains useful through repeated actual finite group orders. Source bodies can carry/hold/move actual objects with real anatomy and source task time; no rest/food/trade/research credit arises automatically. Action, load, injuries, material and costs persist across all elapsed opportunities.

At successful resolution snapshot a closed three-dimensional sphere radius5280ft about that center. Admit a body if any actual occupied portion intersects, including exact equality; use its actual geometry, not bounding-box inclusion where geometry differs. No numerical population cap. AABB fixtures below have exact box occupancy. Center range and area reach are independent.
spellLocalProcedure.allCorpses: NEW every actual eligible corpse in the initial sphere is considered, regardless of individual perception, non-Humanoid type, age, size or opaque burial. This explicitly extends payload admission through intervening ordinary terrain; it does not remove terrain or authorize body motion through it. Animate in existing pose/volume, not forced upright.
